events.event: Komdigi Minister Meutya Hafid denies that Komdigi removed or requested removal of karhutla content, after celebrities and SAFEnet complained of suspected shadowbanning on Instagram/Threads and a removed TikTok video from Siak's regent.
events.key_numbers: Tasya Farasya IG Story views >1 juta -> ~85.000 · Siak TikTok video removed after >5 juta views, later restored · Komdigi earlier admitted 486 content takedowns tied to Aug 2026 demonstrations
events.why_it_matters: Many people suspect platforms hide posts about the smoke crisis; the government says it did not ask for removals.
events.spreading_evidence: detikInet and Katadata tech front pages 21 Oct; celebrity posts

events.event: Ookla's Q3 2026 data shows Indonesia's median mobile download speed at 52.01 Mbps, up 43.4% year on year, ranking 5th of 7 in ASEAN, while 5G median speed of 126.48 Mbps ranks 6th of 7.
events.key_numbers: Mobile median 52,01 Mbps (36,27 Mbps Q3 2025; 24,75 Mbps Q3 2023) · users >=100 Mbps 26% (12%) · 5G median 126,48 Mbps (+55,6%) · 5G availability 34,2% (6,9%) · ASEAN: Singapore 151,89, Malaysia 141,95, Vietnam 126,71, Thailand 110,78, Philippines 50,77 Mbps · 5G rollout concentrated in Jakarta/Java
events.why_it_matters: Your mobile data is much faster than a year ago, but Indonesia still trails Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand.
events.spreading_evidence: Bisnis tekno featured stories 20 Oct (several articles)

events.event: LG CNS Indonesia's president director says early Coretax problems were resolved with a Korean technical team and the system is now more stable; the firm says it does not run daily operations.
events.key_numbers: Coretax contract Rp1,23 triliun · consortium LG CNS + Qualysoft · nationwide use since Jan 2025 · LG CNS in Indonesia since 2006 · claim of stability not independently verified
events.why_it_matters: Coretax is the tax system every taxpayer must use; the vendor says it is now stable, but this is the vendor's own claim.

events.event: LG CNS Indonesia plans a data centre with Sinar Mas, with trial operation planned for 1 December 2026, and acknowledges public concern over electricity and water use.
events.key_numbers: Trial operation 1 Des 2026 · no MW, investment or location disclosed · executive says facility will affect power and water use
events.why_it_matters: Data centres compete with residents for power and water, a theme running through the Batam/Jatiluhur stories.

events.event: Komdigi's Director General of Digital Infrastructure says a draft Perpres on data centres and submarine cables is being finalised after public consultation, aiming to shift data centres to eastern Indonesia beyond Batam and Java.
events.key_numbers: No target date for issuing · Sulawesi and Kupang named as possible sites · energy, water and site suitability named as key variables · no investment figures
events.why_it_matters: The rules will decide where AI data centres get built and who pays for the power.

events.event: Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre (OJK) data shows 637,055 financial-fraud reports between 22 Nov 2024 and 31 Jul 2026, with 607,210 accounts blocked and Rp724.1 billion in fraud funds frozen.
events.key_numbers: 637.055 laporan · 1.179.881 rekening dilaporkan/diverifikasi · 607.210 rekening diblokir · Rp724,1 miliar diblokir · Rp204,3 miliar dikembalikan ke korban · period 22 Nov 2024-31 Jul 2026 · total victim losses not stated
events.why_it_matters: Only about 28% of frozen funds have been returned (Rp204.3 B of Rp724.1 B); reporting fast matters if you are scammed.

events.event: BSSN's deputy head says at Bali Tech Week that BSSN still finds sensitive government data stored and exchanged unencrypted, ahead of the new Satu Data Indonesia law's data-sharing, including for social-protection programmes.
events.key_numbers: Incident reporting required within 24 hours · six security aspects for Satu Data Indonesia law · BSSN cryptography roadmap 2027-2035
events.why_it_matters: The state is about to pool citizens' data while its own cyber agency admits some is unencrypted.

events.event: Katadata reports Prabowo will launch Perlinsos Digital on 10 November 2026, targeting 50 million recipients.
events.key_numbers: Launch 10 Nov 2026 · 50 juta penerima target · article body not read (headline and summary only)
events.why_it_matters: Social aid (PKH/BPNT) is to move onto one digital system, affecting about 50 million people.
